question: What annualized real GDP growth will the BEA report in its advance estimate for Q3 2026, released October 29, 2026?

calls.reasoning: Anchor: late-quarter nowcast consensus vs advance print, error SD ~1pp. Trackers: GDPNow 3.6 (inventories +1.87pp, i.e. half the growth), NY Fed 2.67, Capital Spectator nowcast median 3.2, SPF 2.5, Atlas Analytics 1.5 (net exports -1.5pp after record August imports). Shade below GDPNow, which runs above the advance print and leans on inventories. Median ~2.9. Kalshi (exact contract, but the page was rate-limited, so price date and liquidity are unverified) per snippets: P(>2)=64%, P(>2.5)=59%, P(>3)=42%, P(>4)=20%; that implies a median ~2.8 with fat tails, broadly consistent. Escape mass covers trade/inventory swings past the bounds.
